title: Explainable no-guess Minefield and Extreme Elite echo layers

source.summary: Verify normal no-guess algorithm; explore harder variants and add Extreme Elite with an extra dimension and information strategy; merge. Cropped89% board does not contain enough information to diagnose exact certainty.

outOfScope: General complete CSP or optimal information policy
Finite scan currency, lying clues, probabilistic safety claims

requirements.title: Established deductions with independent checks
requirements.expected: Keep classic9x9/10,16x16/40,30x16/99, safe zero opening and fixed mines. Use local zero/all, global budget and subset subtraction; accepted boards have a certified no-guess route. Visible-state analyzer never reads covered truth or treats user flags as facts; distinguish deduction, contradiction and unsupported stall. Independent oracle, hidden-data tests and genuine50/50 rejection verify soundness.

requirements.title: Show why a move is certain
requirements.expected: Explain gives a concrete safe/mine target, source clue coordinates, counts and rule, including derived proof when needed. Correct a provably safe misplaced flag through explicit player action. Unknown echoes remain unknown; a scan suggestion is an information request, not a safe-cell deduction. No screenshot certainty claim.

requirements.title: Coupled layers and information strategy
requirements.expected: Extreme Elite has two8x8 layers,28 total mines. Local counts8 same-layer neighbors; echo counts aligned3x3 including center in other layer. Reveal safe tile then optionally scan its echo; unlimited permanent scans count once. Win clears all100 safe cells across both layers; safe opening; fixed layout. Certifier scans available safe tiles, completes using cross-clue provenance and subset reasoning while singles-only stalls. No per-layer hidden mine-count leakage. Opening excludes clicked tile and its same-layer8 neighbors only: local0 guaranteed; unscanned echo may be positive. Full-subset local-only certifier must also stall (weak by itself because it cannot initially enter other layer).

requirements.title: Readable personal glass workspace
requirements.expected: Compact elementary/Zorin-inspired controls, pink selection plus restrained field identity, opaque board, gloss bounded to controls. Layer tabs, opened counts, selected coordinate/local/echo inspector and highlighted exact cross footprint make the extra dimension legible. Elite revealed click selects; explicit C/Shiftclick local chord, F/rightclick/cancellable touch hold flag, Enter reveal, E scan. No slogans/Cell size/Flag mode. Classic min24px and Elite min32px; no unexplained overflow. At320x640 retain at least192px of visible board height; compact inspector never pushes controls offscreen. Long proof may open an explicitly bounded closable detail dialog; only its detail scrolls. Persistent source coordinate survives layer switching; target footprint is exact, including clipped edges.

requirements.title: Bounded responsive generation and recovery
requirements.expected: Progress reports stage/attempts/elapsed with unknown total indeterminate; attempt/time cap8s and main watchdog10s. New game/level change cancels; stale results cannot overwrite. Error Retry reaches genuine play; never fall back to an uncertified board.

requirements.title: Repeatable source-bound release
requirements.expected: Current request is selected once for CLI/CI. Request readiness before implementation, frozen affected checks and required full CI, independent candidate and actual deployed reviews, durable evidence and explicit acceptance decision.

risks.risk: Screenshot crop omits clues/global budget and wrong flags can obstruct play
risks.resolution: Do not diagnose unseen full board. Analyze actual public revealed clues and global budget; ignore player flags as truth; explain safe flagged-cell correction.

risks.risk: A certifier validating itself can hide soundness errors
risks.resolution: Independent small-board feasible-world enumeration and hidden-data noninterference tests; trace correctness and late global-budget/ambiguous fixtures. Bounded evidence is not universal proof.

risks.risk: Cross-layer combined counts can generate symmetric ambiguous fields
risks.resolution: Split local8 and cross3x3/9 clues; reject uncertified boards. Full all-echo solver must solve, single-rule-only solver must stall, and a traced deduction must use cross clues.

risks.risk: Information purchases can strand a player
risks.resolution: Echo scans are unlimited and permanent, counted only for efficiency, with no optimality claim; certifier may scan all safely revealed tiles. Truthful fixed clues only.

risks.risk: Double clues increase visual and cognitive load
risks.resolution: One8x8 layer at a time, local/echo labels and coordinate inspector, minimum32px Elite cells, fixed tabs. No color-only layer identity. Explain is optional; no decorative rainbow.

risks.risk: Generation retry or stale worker could freeze or replace a new game
risks.resolution: Attempt/time bound8s in worker plus10s main-thread watchdog, responsive cancel/reset, error/retry and epoch guards. Never return uncertified fallback.

rollbackTriggers: False certainty or unverified board admitted
Essential controls inaccessible or generation cannot recover
rollout.hotfixPolicy: Isolated recoverable defect blocks acceptance; linked hotfix repeats affected scenarios.
